description: Regression fixture cases pinned against prior core suite results to detect model output drift. Case files live in cases/ and are loaded in filename order.

case_schema.fixture_version: integer, bumped when case content changes meaningfully
case_schema.prompt_version: prompt template identity used by the fixture
case_schema.response_schema: JSON Schema object; identical across models

expectations.required_fields: dotted field paths that must appear in parsed output
expectations.allowed_evidence_ids: evidence ids the output may cite; citing others fails
expectations.forbidden_phrases: case-insensitive substrings that must not appear
